purpose: Faithfully serialize the existing frozen Macro utility plus CE attribution claim. Not a new experiment, metric choice, policy change, or accepted standard v3 L4 card.
joint_claim: Both trained-head Macro utility over uniform and within-selected-model context-alignment CE impairment hold under the original independent approximately-normal seed-difference assumption on this fixed benchmark.

endpoints.original_gate: Q-minus-uniform test full40 Macro-F1: mean>0, at least4/5 positive, paired-t two-sided95% CI lower>0.
Q fixed-selected checkpoint all-test mean CE(shuffled)-CE(actual): mean>0, at least4/5 positive, paired-t two-sided95% CI lower>0; every seed uniform CE delta abs<=2e-5 and identity residual<=2e-5.

decision.rule: All original critical gates must pass; no endpoint substitution, OR rule, best-of-family or optional seed extension.
decision.multiplicity: Implied intersection-union for this sole conjunction. Two marginal95% intervals are not a simultaneous95% region. No retrospective correction is called predeclared.

secondary_sensitivity.name: Exact two-sided sign flip
secondary_sensitivity.role: Original descriptive robustness/symmetry sensitivity, not the predeclared t gate; it does not pass .05 and must remain visible.

auxiliary_macro.role: Recorded actual-minus-shuffled Macro, posthoc supporting consistency only; not an attribution-confirmation gate.

required_representation_checks: Explicit metric, direction, raw paired method/baseline values, unit and planned seeds per endpoint.
Training utility is Macro; the frozen matched intervention endpoint is CE. Preserve their separate identities.
Type main gate p and descriptive sensitivity p separately; never erase .0625 or label it the paired-t p.
Bind the trained uniform ablation to Macro and exact selected-checkpoint replacement to CE, retaining existing control fairness and scope limits.
Audit all critical frozen endpoints, n5 assumptions and conjunctive decision semantics before accepting any registration.
Preserve legacy cards and reject attempts to rename a CE effect as Macro or to promote the auxiliary Macro gate.
A shared schema/validator change is separate work; this proposal does not authorize changing it.
resource_action: No new training, test replay, GPU allocation, COS restore or raw transfer is justified solely by this representation gap.
future_science: A claim robust to weaker distribution assumptions, a new test population, or unique quantum benefit requires its own prospectively fixed design; this audit does not promise it.
